identificationModule.briefTitle: Clinical Trial Comparing TQB2868 Injection Combined With Anlotinib Hydrochloride Capsules With Placebo Combined With Chemotherapy as First-line Treatment for Metastatic Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma (mPDAC)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double-blind, Parallel-controlled, Multicenter Phase III Clinical Trial Comparing TQB2868 Injection Combined With Anlotinib Hydrochloride Capsules to Placebo Combined With Chemotherapy as First-line Treatment for Metastatic Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma (mPDAC)

leadSponsor.name: Shanghai Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Technology Development Co., Ltd.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study adopts a randomized, open label, placebo-controlled, multicenter trial design. OS was the primary endpoint, and eligible subjects were randomly divided into 1:1 groups and received TQB2868 injection and anlotinib hydrochloride capsules combined with chemotherapy, compared to placebo combined with chemotherapy.

armGroups.label: TQB2868 Injection+Anlotinib Hydrochloride Capsules+chemotherapy
armGroups.description: TQB2868 Injection+Anlotinib Hydrochloride Capsules+Gemcitabine Hydrochloride Injection+Paclitaxel for Injection

armGroups.label: TQB2868 Placebo+Anlotinib Hydrochloride Capsules+chemotherapy
armGroups.description: TQB2868 Placebo+Anlotinib Hydrochloride Capsules+Gemcitabine Hydrochloride Injection+Paclitaxel for Injection

interventions.name: TQB2868 Injection
interventions.description: TQB2868 injection: PD-L1 and Transforming Growth Factor-beta (TGF - β) dual antibody

primaryOutcomes.description: By evaluating overall survival (OS), this study aims to demonstrate the efficacy of TQB2868 injection combined with anlotinib hydrochloride capsules in chemotherapy compared to placebo combined with chemotherapy in the first-line treatment of metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (mPDAC).

secondaryOutcomes.description: Evaluate the effectiveness of TQB2868 injection and anlotinib hydrochloride capsules combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo combined with chemotherapy in first-line treatment of metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (mPDAC) using the Progression-Free Survival evaluated by researchers.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Objective Response Rate evaluated by researchers
secondaryOutcomes.description: Evaluate the effectiveness of TQB2868 injection and anlotinib hydrochloride capsules combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo combined with chemotherapy in first-line treatment of metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (mPDAC) using the Objective Response Rate evaluated by researchers.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: The Disease Control Rate evaluated by the researchers
secondaryOutcomes.description: Evaluate the effectiveness of TQB2868 injection and anlotinib hydrochloride capsules combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo combined with chemotherapy in first-line treatment of metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (mPDAC) using the Disease Control Rate evaluated by researchers.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: The Duration of Response (DOR) evaluated by the researchers
secondaryOutcomes.description: Evaluate the effectiveness of TQB2868 injection and anlotinib hydrochloride capsules combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo combined with chemotherapy in first-line treatment of metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (mPDAC) using the Duration of Response evaluated by researchers.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: The Time to Tumor Recurrence evaluated by the researchers
secondaryOutcomes.description: Evaluate the effectiveness of TQB2868 injection and anlotinib hydrochloride capsules combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo combined with chemotherapy in first-line treatment of metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (mPDAC) using the Time to Tumor Recurrence evaluated by researchers.

Evaluate the safety of TQB2868 injection and anlotinib hydrochloride capsules combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo combined with chemotherapy in first-line treatment of metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (mPDAC) by assessing the incidence and severity of adverse events, determined according to the NCI Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) 5.0 grading scale.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Sign the informed consent form, and until 28 days after the last medication administration
